projects.title: Public Text Classification Capstone
bullets: Cleaned public discussion-topic text records with Python and pandas for a supervised undergraduate capstone on short-document classification.
Implemented a bag-of-words classifier with scikit-learn and documented the training and test splits used for the capstone classification task.

research.title: Environmental Time Series Forecasting
bullets: Aligned public air-quality sensor time series using Python and pandas as a research assistant contributing to supervised faculty research.
Implemented a seasonal baseline and plotted forecast residuals for the forecasting task involving public environmental time series.

research.title: Product Review Classification Errors
bullets: Implemented a bag-of-words classifier using Python and scikit-learn for public product-review text as part of supervised faculty research.
Compared classification errors across document lengths and documented training and test splits for the short public text documents.
